cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Interesting. The picnic moved from Saturday to Friday. Whose blue pen is that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And whose handwriting adds hearts to Fridays?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Now, who should tell the Saturday guests?

mechanism: A poses identification questions as a pupil observation exercise until B owns a calendar change, then pursues responsibility for its consequences.
confusable: Not an accusation delivered outright: each apparently innocent question narrows the alteration through observable clues.
comparison: Calendar handwriting ownership versus furniture rearrangement and relocated belongings.
seedUse: Keep D40 pen/hearts/Friday/Saturday guests; S05 handwriting lesson makes the revealing clue part of claimed influence.
